challenge: Execution of a special architectural city entrance structure requiring customized aluminium cladding coordination, precision detailing, curved geometry control, waterproofing continuity, and accurate architectural finishing.
sipanel_solution: SIPANEL developed a customized aluminium cladding and structural coordination system specifically engineered for the project’s architectural geometry, curved transitions, and facade integration requirements.
engineering_decision: Engineering teams designed curved transition details, edge coordination systems, structural alignment strategies, and sealing workflows to preserve architectural consistency and long-term facade durability.
execution_detail: Installation followed controlled sequencing procedures, detailed engineering drawings, alignment verification checkpoints, and coordinated sealing execution to ensure accurate geometry and clean architectural integration.
measured_result: Successful delivery of a durable and visually distinctive aluminium-clad city entrance structure with precise geometry execution and reliable weather-resistant performance.
primary_message: Precision-engineered aluminium cladding systems designed for complex architectural entrance structures.
